description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Granting permisson for purchasing, transferring & makiing payments in respect of SLDBs & for the export of Bonds
categorisation: This gazette notice contains regulatory permissions granted by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka under the Exchange Control Act, specifically outlining who can purchase, transfer, and make payments for Sri Lanka Development Bonds. It deals with legal/regulatory framework for foreign exchange controls and financial transactions, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for statutory instruments and regulatory compliance matters.
